name: agent-kit
description: Model, run and extend LeanScope choreos — scripted conversations between AI personas and humans — from your coding agent, on your own LeanScope repository and your own LLM keys.

token.title: LeanScope personal team-repos access token
token.description: Names the LeanScope repository your choreos live in. Stored in your OS credential store.

openai.title: OpenAI API key
openai.description: Optional. Sent to the agent server per session, never stored there. Leave empty if your choreos don't use it.

anthropic.title: Anthropic API key
anthropic.description: Optional. Sent to the agent server per session, never stored there. Leave empty if your choreos don't use it.

mistral.description: Optional. Sent to the agent server per session, never stored there. Leave empty if your choreos don't use it.
